---
title: "03 · Binary Search"
---

Binary search finds a target in sorted data by repeatedly halving the search
range. Step through it below: pick a target, then move the slider to watch
`low`, `high`, and `mid` narrow the range one comparison at a time.

```{python}
#| echo: false
def binary_search_steps(nums, target):
    steps = []
    low, high = 0, len(nums) - 1
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        val = nums[mid]
        if val == target:
            steps.append({
                "low": low, "high": high, "mid": mid,
                "desc": f"nums[{mid}] = {val} equals target {target} — found!",
            })
            return steps, mid
        elif val < target:
            steps.append({
                "low": low, "high": high, "mid": mid,
                "desc": f"nums[{mid}] = {val} < target {target} → search the right half.",
            })
            low = mid + 1
        else:
            steps.append({
                "low": low, "high": high, "mid": mid,
                "desc": f"nums[{mid}] = {val} > target {target} → search the left half.",
            })
            high = mid - 1
    steps.append({
        "low": low, "high": high, "mid": None,
        "desc": f"low ({low}) > high ({high}) — search space exhausted, target {target} not found.",
    })
    return steps, -1


demo_nums = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 18, 21, 25]
demo_targets = [21, 7, 6]  # found late, found early, not found

scenarios = []
for t in demo_targets:
    steps, result = binary_search_steps(demo_nums, t)
    scenarios.append({"target": t, "steps": steps, "result": result})

bs_max_step = max(len(s["steps"]) for s in scenarios) - 1

ojs_define(bs_nums=demo_nums, bs_scenarios=scenarios, bs_max_step=bs_max_step)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof bsTarget = Inputs.select(
  bs_scenarios.map((s) => s.target),
  { label: "Target", value: bs_scenarios[0].target }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Static range, independent of bsTarget/bsScenario -- a slider whose bounds
// depend on another reactive input has to be torn down and rebuilt every time
// that input changes, which is a common source of "the widget stops responding"
// bugs. Keeping it static means it's built once; the render cell clamps instead.
viewof bsStepIndex = Inputs.range(
  [0, bs_max_step],
  { step: 1, value: 0, label: "Step" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
bsScenario = bs_scenarios.find((s) => s.target === bsTarget)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
bsClampedStep = Math.min(bsStepIndex, bsScenario.steps.length - 1)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
bsStep = bsScenario.steps[bsClampedStep]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const cellBox = (i) => {
    const inRange = i >= bsStep.low && i <= bsStep.high;
    const isMid = i === bsStep.mid;
    const found = isMid && bsStep.desc.includes("found!");
    let bg = "transparent", fg = "inherit", border = "1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc)", opacity = 1;
    if (!inRange) opacity = 0.35;
    if (inRange && !isMid) { bg = "rgba(13,110,253,0.12)"; border = "1px solid #0d6efd"; }
    if (isMid) { bg = found ? "#198754" : "#0d6efd"; fg = "white"; border = `1px solid ${bg}`; }
    return `background:${bg}; color:${fg}; border:${border}; opacity:${opacity};`;
  };
  const label = (i) => {
    if (i === bsStep.mid) return "mid";
    if (i === bsStep.low) return "low";
    if (i === bsStep.high) return "high";
    return "";
  };
  return html`<div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem;">
      ${bs_nums.map((v, i) => html`
        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:2.75rem;">
          <div style="width:2.5rem; height:2.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center;
                      justify-content:center; border-radius:6px; font-weight:600;
                      font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); ${cellBox(i)}">${v}</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.65rem; opacity:0.6; margin-top:2px;">${label(i)}</div>
        </div>
      `)}
    </div>
    <p style="margin-top:0.75rem;"><strong>Step ${bsClampedStep + 1} / ${bsScenario.steps.length}:</strong> ${bsStep.desc}</p>
    ${bsClampedStep === bsScenario.steps.length - 1
      ? html`<p><strong>Result:</strong> ${bsScenario.result === -1 ? "not found (-1)" : `found at index ${bsScenario.result}`}</p>`
      : ""}
  </div>`;
}
```
